conflicts.issue: 24,054 m² current profile versus 24,053 m² archival report (source publisher/date differ). Require cadastral/legal document.
Article credits press 2006-07-12 yet states announcement morning 2006-07-15. Preserve as claimed/forecast until chronology checked.
Initial 2007 projected handover 2010-Q2; 2008 article states June 2009 early access possible. Not proof of actual phase handover.
42 blocks >3000 homes references entire Sky Garden I–III; 1715 apartments and 56 shops references Sky Garden III only. Avoid double count and verify products vs apartments.
One PMH microsite says 673 products; another says 671 apartments +51 shops (722); retrospective says >720 apartments & shops. Preserve separately pending building-level reconciliation.
Early 2014 design labels B/C1/C2/D1/D2/E1/E2 vs later launch tower F/H. Planning snapshots or renaming; no inferred tower map.
2014 press projects stage-1 completion Sept 2016; undated developer profile states completed/handover. Actual handover date not verified.
Four archive child records point to hist-phumyhungmidtown, absent from 150 canonical IDs. Proposed review-only remap to map-midtown. Change generator and index coherently only after review.
2,439 total 'products' in developer historical marketing includes apartments plus commercial units; do not convert to flat count or sum child phases twice.
271 and 245 are separate 2018 sales wave apartment counts; 516 flats + 103 shops = 619 total in handover article; do not sum waves to all-products.
Some historical articles hosted by developer reproduce journalism (e.g. VnExpress/Người Đô Thị), publication and original rights must be confirmed. Do not reprint content.
